name: Places
about: Searches Google Maps from the phone with your own Maps Platform key.

settings.name: key
settings.label: Maps API key
settings.obtain: In the Google Cloud console make a project with billing, enable the Places API (New) and the Geocoding API, then APIs & Services, Credentials, Create credentials, API key. Restrict the key to those two APIs.

limits: Searches, place details and photos are billed to your Google Cloud project (Google's free monthly credit covers light use).

delta.about: The command center keeps the Maps key (GET /maps-key); the phone still calls Google itself.
